description: The useful-answer set's CPU Q4_K control (artifacts/useful-answer-set-20261014): its frozen run-arm.py and doppler-text.mjs, unchanged, on mac-host CPU with 4 threads. The application's template, tokenizer and incremental decoder from the Doppler archive; transformers float32 arithmetic over the deployed Q4_K bytes. Not the GPU route.
routePromptTokenLimitSource: answer-set.json settings.promptTokenLimit: the installed route cannot take much more than about 270 prompt tokens.
